fields.name: inheritance
fields.definition:
If needed, specify the parent animation graph and any inheritance settings desired.
Any animations from the parent graph which are not already present here will be available at runtime,
even though you will not see them populated in this animation graph.

fields.name: events
fields.definition:
Keyframe events are stored and edited in an external tag file to support multiple authors.
The contents of that tag file will be loaded into this animation graph at runtime.

fields.name: pca animation
fields.definition:
PCA Blend Shape Animation data is stored in an external file due to it's size.
If you do not specify a file here, one will be created for you if blend shape animation is imported.

Compression
fields.definition:
Warning: Changing this compression setting will force that setting on animations in the graph.
This is suitable for pre-testing different compression levels, but should not be used long term.

fields.name: IK Junctions
fields.definition: IK Junctions are rigid parts of the IK solver. Hips and Shoulder areas, for exampleThese are optional, but required when full-body IK influence is desired

fields.name: IK Chains
fields.definition: IK chains define full limbs like arms and legs. These are controlled byanimation events to lock the limb endpoints to key locations. They are also used to connect junctions

fields.name: Points and Sets
fields.definition:
Define a set of IK connection points, and combine them into sets.
You can then references these ik sets in the Mode & State tree below.

Pull settings
fields.definition: Controls how much the chain can push or pull it's parent junction

fields.name: native pull strength#how much this chain wants to pull it's junction, even when not fully extended
native push strength#how much this chain wants to push it's junction, even when not fully extended
over extent pull strength#how much this chain wants to pull it's junction when beyond full extension
under extent push strength#how much this chain wants to push it's junction when below min extension

a!
fields.definition:
IMPORTANT NOTES ABOUT FRAME EVENTS
1) The following four fields (hidden except in expert mode) are legacy Halo3-style tag blocks.
2) New frame events (attached to animations in Maya) will automagically be exported to
   the frame_event_list any time a model sidecar is imported with the tool import command.
3) Do not add new frame events, fx events, audio events, or dialog events here.  Instead,
   please use the frame_event_list tag referenced in 'imported events' (it's right above the
   'animations' tag block).
4) The only time you should be editing the following hidden fields is to remove legacy
   frame events that have been replaced by events generated in Maya.

fields.name: frame events|ABCDCC!*#Legacy field - please edit in new frame event tag below
sound events|ABCDCC!*#Legacy field - please edit in new frame event tag below
effect events|ABCDCC!*#Legacy field - please edit in new frame event tag below
dialogue events|ABCDCC!*#Legacy field - please edit in new frame event tag below
PCA Groups
fields.definition:
For each PCA Group desired, provide a unique name and desired number of blend shapes.
Then, assign animations to these groups by setting their pca group name field.
This is how blend shapes animations are grouped for compression.

fields.name: PCA Component Importance
fields.definition:
The PCA compression algorithm treats position, normal, and tension data as equally
important when calculating error.  Use the values below to prioritize various
componenents so they are "more important" when determining error, and therefore
are higher proirity for the algorithm to make accurate.

fields.name: interpolation rate:[0,1]#A value of zero or one means no interpolation.
yaw source object function#if used, make sure you set the yaw source to 'object function'
pitch source object function#if used, make sure you set the pitch source to 'object function'
weight source#the primary weight control source
secondary weight source#the optional secondary weight control source. Modulated with the primary if used.
weight source object function#if used, make sure you set the weight source to 'object function'
secondary weight object function#if used, make sure you set the secondary weight source to 'object function'
weight function#Function applied to input from weight function source
unlock function#function output must match unlock value for this overlay to play
unlock range#Unlocks this overlay when the unlock function values falls in this range. Unused when function isn't specified
start LOD taper#Percent of screen size at which we start to taper off application of the function overlay
end LOD taper#Percent of screen size at which we disable application of the function overlay
bone mask#bones this interpolator applies to
seconds#total interpolation time in seconds. recommended value= 0.25
default curve#for all bones not included in specific interpolators above
state name^#name of the state this transition starts in
mode name#name of the mode this transition ends in
state name#name of the state this transition ends in
transition lerp:NONE=engine default#interpolation to use when no animation is present. NONE=engine default
transition anim#When set, takes priority over a transition lerp
anim timing function#when set, this function will control the transition animation playback from 0-1
anim lerp in:NONE=engine default#interpolation to use when starting the transition anim. NONE=engine default
anim lerp out:NONE=engine default#interpolation to use when exiting the transition anim. NONE=engine default
marker#the marker name on the object being attached
attach to marker#the marker name object (weapon, vehicle, etc.) the above marker is being attached to

priority source object function#allows a function to adjust the priority of this chain in the full body solve

fields.definition: fields used by varous compression codecs to store shared or global data for this graph. Do not manually edit.

possesses default ik chains for a biped
invert#the mask includes everything except the nodes set below
static#this joint will be unchanged by IK
hinge#special marking of extra hinges for limbs only. Max 2
Disable Quadruped Footlocking#stop the front feet (if any) from performing footlocking
Enable Biped Handlocking#Enable groundfitting of hands
disable interpolation in#when set, no other animation may interpolate into this one. It will just pop to this animation instead.
disable interpolation out#when set, this animation may not interpolate into any other. It will just pop to the new animation.
disable mode ik#(Bipeds Only) disable any mode ik (found in the mode and state tree) for the entire animation. Typically, this is IK to tie hands/feet to vehicle locations.
disable weapon ik#(Bipeds Only) disable any weapon ik (found in the mode and state tree) for the entire animation. Typically, this is IK to tie secondary hands to weapon locations.
disable weapon aim/1st person#(Bipeds,Vehicles Only) disable aim screens while this animation is playing.
disable look screen#(Bipeds,Vehicles Only) disable look screens while this animation is playing.
disable transition adjustment# DEPRECATED, will be ignored
force weapon ik on#(Bipeds,Vehicles Only) force any weapon ik to be on while this animation is playing.
use custom blend-in time#when possible, interpolate into this animation using the 'blend in' time value below
enable animated source interpolation#Cross-fade animations instead of interpolating. Requires Dual Mixing Board setting in graph flags.
disable ik sets#(Bipeds Only) disable all IK sets while this animation is playing.
disable ik chains#(Bipeds Only) disable all IK chains while this animation is playing.
translate and scale root only#ignore all translation and scale on all nodes except the root
enable blend-out on replacement anims#(Replacement Anims Only) fade this replacement animation out as playback nears the end. Fades over 8 frames.
use custom blend-out time#(Replacement Anims Only) when possible, fade this animation out over the 'blend out' time below instead of the default 8 frames. Requires enable blend-out flag above.
override player input#(Player Only) use the movement data in this animation instead of player physics. Use only when animation must control the player verbatim.
